Real sunshine, clear directional shadows, optical depth of field; camera tracking the running child, modest directional motion blur on the lane edges. Camera behind him at low human height. No other people. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, poster design or frames. No digital painting, illustration, animation, cartoon, game render, doll, plastic skin, enlarged eyes, artificial gloss, painterly texture or repeating procedural surface pattern. Keep the entire frame photographic and natural.
Output portrait aspect ratio 941:1672, target 941x1672 pixels. Match the attached portrait composition closely: full boy at the center, his hat/finial near y=28 percent, lowest shoe at y=75 percent, entire flowing cloak inside the frame. The broad cape billows to the left. Keep ample sky above and stone paving below. ALL of the boy including the finial, braid, fingers, cape hem and both shoes must remain inside the centered 3:4 crop, which retains vertical y=12.5 to87.5 percent. prompts.prompt:
An unretouched color photograph from a real historical-costume location shoot in Beijing's Forbidden City, captured with a full-frame DSLR and a physical lens in clear midday sunlight. He wears an actual black Qing cloth hat with a small red finial, long dark braided queue down his back, a warm imperial-yellow silk-brocade dragon robe and a loose long yellow embroidered cloak billowing leftward, charcoal cloth trousers, black cloth shoes with pale worn soles. Tall timeworn red plaster walls and gray stone bases flank the alley, ochre-golden glazed roof tiles and small roof ornaments, muted teal wooden eaves, a distant arched gateway, a real blue sky with wispy white clouds. The ground is uneven, worn gray stone paving. Camera follows the running child from low human eye height behind him, torso and face in focus, restrained physical panning motion blur confined to the outer walls and paving, believable lens depth. Natural highlights and hard sunlight shadows, plausible camera exposure, no HDR glow. Documentary photography and costume fabric realism. This must look convincingly taken with a real camera, with a human child actor on a real location. NO animation style, no CGI, no 3D render, no illustration, no digitally painted surface, no oversized eyes, no plastic skin, no doll, no logos, no lettering, no watermarks, no other people. Do not turn it into a movie poster.
Vertical portrait format, target 941x1672 pixels (9:16). Entire boy visible, from hat finial to shoes, occupying x12–78percent and y28–77percent; face at aboutx58percent/y35percent, leftward blowing cloak occupying left center. Full body, both feet and cape hems clearly inside the image. Plenty of empty sky in upper quarter and gray paving below. The camera observes him at medium distance, not a close portrait.
